channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Bets iniciaram rodadas de demissões após proibição, mostra relatório
item.description: Following President Lula's veto on online betting, at least 36 of the 188 licensed betting brands have initiated layoffs, according to a survey by Amig. The measure directly impacts the digital gaming sector and has consequences on informal economy and labor market.

item.title: Flávio diz que usará maioria no Congresso para “mudar a Constituição”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, stated that congressional majority will enable constitutional changes, highlighting PL's expanded caucus after the 2026 elections. He also announced support alliance with Ronaldo Caiado for the runoff against Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deve usar Tarcísio para tentar virar votos na Grande SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas, elected governor of São Paulo, is set to support Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff campaign, aiming to flip votes in São Paulo and counter Lula. The strategy involves events with mayors and joint actions in Greater São Paulo.

item.title: Eleito deputado federal, acusado de ser membro do PCC teve 118 mil votos
item.description: Ney Santos (Republicanos), former mayor of Embu das Artes, was elected federal deputy with 118,566 votes in São Paulo, despite being accused of ties to the PCC and facing charges including money laundering and gang formation. The Electoral Public Ministry challenged his candidacy, but the São Paulo Electoral Court approved it after a split vote; the case is pending review by the TSE.

item.title: Confira os percursos das provas do Metrópoles Endurance Corrida
item.description: The Metrópoles Endurance Race takes place on October 24, 2026 in Brasília, featuring 4 km, 8 km, and 16 km routes departing from the Cathedral. Registrations are valid until October 19 and cost R$89 plus 1 kg of food.

item.title: Moraes recebe Andrei e outros chefes da PF no Supremo
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes met with Federal Police leaders suspected of spying on Supreme Court justices. The unrecorded meeting takes place as Moraes faces investigation for allegedly aiding Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master. Andrei Rodrigues and Leandro Almada were suspended and later reinstated amid misconduct allegations.

item.title: Veja a nova composição da Câmara dos Deputados em gráficos e compare com 2022
item.description: The PL leads the new composition of the Chamber of Deputies with 121 seats, followed by PT (70) and União Brasil (46). The number of elected women rose to 109, representing 21.2% of the seats, but the chamber remains predominantly male and white.

item.title: Na eleição para a Câmara, famosos dão lugar a 'políticos influencers'
item.description: In the 2026 Chamber of Deputies elections, traditional media celebrities were defeated by 'politician influencers' who leveraged social media to build audiences and convert followers into votes. Candidates like Nikolas Ferreira, Lucas Pavanato and Erika Hilton led the vote count, while celebrities such as Tiririca, Manoel Gomes and Silvia Abravanel failed to win. This shift reflects a changing relationship between fame and politics, with digital influencers replacing traditional celebrities.

item.title: Resultado das eleições 2026: veja os votos por seção eleitoral em todas as cidades do país
item.description: G1 publishes the results of the 2026 elections with votes for president by electoral section across Brazil, based on TSE data. The data allows checking the voting in each polling place but does not indicate the winner or who advanced to the second round. The report is produced automatically with AI, under journalists' supervision.

item.title: Com derrota de Roseana, família Sarney fica sem mandato pela primeira vez em 72 anos
item.description: With the defeat of Roseana Sarney (MDB-MA) in the Federal Senate race, the Sarney family will be without an elected mandate in 2027, ending a 72-year cycle in Brazilian politics. André Fufuca (PP) and Lahesio Bonfim (Novo) secured the two seats with 21.43% and 20.65% of the votes, respectively. No other family member is positioned to assume an elected office from 2027 onward.

item.title: Grupo de Paes pede que TSE negue pedido de Garotinho sobre eleição
item.description: Eduardo Paes' coalition asked the TSE to reject Anthony Garotinho's withdrawal request from his appeal, arguing it would harm the election and benefit the PL. Garotinho's candidacy was rejected in September due to suspended political rights.

item.title: Saiba como será a devolução do dinheiro das bets a quem perdeu o prazo
item.description: Following the shutdown of authorized betting platforms in Brazil, approximately R$1.325 billion must be refunded to 26.5 million bettors, with a deadline that expired on October 5, 2026. Companies are required to transfer remaining balances to financial institutions for repayment between October 9 and 14, with Caixa Econômica Federal assuming unclaimed funds. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) banned betting activities through a Provisional Measure, which also authorized reviews of accounts to detect potential money laundering.

item.title: São Paulo e Fluminense trocam marca de bet por Superscore
item.description: São Paulo FC and Fluminense will feature the Superscore brand on their kits as part of a deal with Superbet, complying with MP 1.394/2026 which bans betting advertisements in Brazilian football. Superscore is described as a sports intelligence app with no betting content. Other teams such as Sport, Athletic, and Goiás also adjusted their sponsorships due to the new regulation.

item.title: Flávio e Lula miram 9 milhões de votos de derrotados e 8 milhões que não votaram no Nordeste
item.description: The first round of the 2026 presidential election confirmed a polarized race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), who will face off in the runoff. Both candidates target the 9 million voters who backed the eliminated candidates and the 8 million non-voters, especially in the Northeast. The scenario points to a race shaped by ideological alignment and coalition-building strategies.

item.title: PSDB tem maioria de diretórios estaduais com posição pró-Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PSDB has a majority of state directories with a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro stance in the second round. The national president of the party, Aécio Neves, has begun consulting state directories on the party's positioning in the presidential election.

item.title: Mirando 2º turno, Lula endurece discurso contra Flávio
item.description: Lula adjusts the strategy for the second round, hardening the speech against Flávio Bolsonaro and focusing on rights, public policies and cost of life. The campaign prioritizes direct attacks on the opponent instead of focusing on Bolsonarism, with new materials and possible changes in the communication team.

item.title: Pesquisa testa disputa de segundo turno entre Flávio e Lula no terceiro maior colégio eleitoral do país
item.description: A new Quaest poll in Rio de Janeiro measures second-round voting intention between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula for president, and between Douglas Ruas and Eduardo Paes for governor. The survey also assesses candidate image, expectations of victory, and key voter concerns, with results scheduled for release on October 12.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro articula ida ao Amazonas para impulsionar candidata do PL
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) plans to visit Amazonas before the runoff to support PL candidate Maria do Carmo for governor against Senator Omar Aziz (PSD), an ally of Lula (PT). Aziz leads with 40.63% of valid votes, while Maria do Carmo has 24.49%.

item.title: Times jogam sem patrocínio de bets nas camisas no 1º dia de proibição
item.description: Brazilian football teams played without betting sponsors on the first day of the ban established by MP 1.394/2026, signed by President Lula. Sport, Athletic, and Goiás replaced betting brands on their shirts, while Goiás kept Viva Sorte, classified as charity. The measure prohibits sports betting and online games in the country.

item.title: Resultado das eleições 2026: como foi a votação na sua cidade no 1º turno; consulte por estado
item.description: G1 publishes the voting results for the first round of the 2026 elections for president, governor, senator, and representatives across all cities in the country, based on data from the TSE. The data allows users to check the vote by state and city, without indicating winners or candidates who advanced to the second round.

item.title: TSE marca para quinta-feira julgamento que pode definir eleição no Rio
item.description: The TSE will rule on Thursday whether Garotinho can withdraw his appeal, potentially leading to vote annulment and the proclamation of Douglas Ruas as the elected governor of Rio de Janeiro in the first round.

item.title: Debate seria melhor para Lula ou Flávio? O que diz CEO de instituto de pesquisa
item.description: The CEO of the Ideia Institute of Research believes a debate between Lula and Flávio would be strategically more advantageous for the president, who needs to create events and change the dynamics of the race. For Flávio, the risk would be exposing his proposals and accepting direct questioning, which could harm his defensive campaign.

item.title: Senado discute fim da escala 6x1, aposta de Lula para o segundo turno
item.description: The Senate began discussing the amendment bill proposing the end of the 6x1 scale, an electoral strategy by President Lula to gain advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Agro está sofrendo muito com esse governo, tratado como inimigo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Lula government for treating agribusiness as an enemy, emphasizing his commitment to the FPA's agenda. He highlighted the need to address the sector's struggles under the current administration.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Estou esperançoso com retaguarda de lideranças comigo como Tarcísio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expressed optimism about alliances for the second round and highlighted Tarcísio de Freitas' (Republicanos) support, reinforcing strategies for future elections.

item.title: Pedro Lupion: 'O campo não aguenta mais esse governo e vamos eleger Flávio Bolsonaro'
item.description: Federal deputy Pedro Lupion, president of the Parliamentary Front of Agriculture (FPA), criticized the agricultural and economic policies of Lula's government, stating that rural areas can no longer endure the current administration and declaring support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro perde para Lula na seção eleitoral em que vota no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: At the polling station where Flávio Bolsonaro votes in Rio de Janeiro, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) received 146 votes, surpassing the senator from PL, who got 127 votes. Lula led with 49% of the votes, while Flávio obtained around 43%, according to projections.

item.title: OEA aponta tensão na eleição brasileira e cobra segurança jurídica
item.description: The OAS released a preliminary report from its observation mission of the first round of the Brazilian elections, describing the contest as being conducted in 'a climate of tension and strong political polarization'. The document recommends that, in the second round, candidates and parties ensure 'maximum legal security' to conduct their campaigns. The organization also emphasized the importance of ensuring transparency and respect for electoral norms.

item.title: Quais são os caminhos para Lula no segundo turno, segundo CEO de instituto de pesquisa
item.description: Cila Schulman, CEO of Ideia Instituto de Pesquisa, assesses that Lula faces difficulties in expanding his electorate in the second round, since 90% of his supporters already voted for him in the first round. She highlights as paths: mobilizing non-voters, recovering votes in the Northeast, and deepening dialogue with the C class and women.

item.title: Renan Santos nega ter sido procurado por PT ou Centrão para aliança
item.description: Renan Santos, leader of Missão, denied being approached by PT or Centrão for an alliance in the second round during an interview with SBT News. He emphasized prioritizing the structuring of the party, which elected only two deputies, and reaffirmed he would not support unaligned alliances.

item.title: Plenário do TSE vai analisar caso Garotinho nesta quinta-feira
item.description: The TSE plenary will analyze Anthony Garotinho's case on Thursday, regarding his attempt to withdraw the appeal seeking to validate his candidacy for Rio de Janeiro governor, which may lead to the definitive annulment of his votes and the victory of Douglas Ruas (PL). If accepted, the ruling could pave the way for declaring Ruas the winner, after he secured 49.2% of valid votes in the first round, surpassing Eduardo Paes (PSD). Paes accuses Garotinho of using a deceptive strategy to benefit Ruas, allegedly aided by Wladimir Garotinho, elected federal deputy for the PL.

item.title: “Se não fosse Flávio, 6 X 1 já teria acabado”, diz Rick Azevedo
item.description: Federal deputy-elect Rick Azevedo (PSOL-RJ) criticized the slow progress of the PEC eliminating the 6x1 workweek, blaming the PL and Flávio Bolsonaro by labeling their stance as pro-employer and anti-worker. He emphasized that approval depends on popular mobilization and could boost Lula's image defending workers' rights.

item.title: TSE nega que atraso na divulgação dos resultados tenha comprometido apuração dos votos
item.description: The TSE stated that the delay in publishing the presidential election results did not affect the vote counting, only the online data display. A data processing holdup froze a system module responsible for disseminating results, but vote tabulation and calculations continued normally. The court denied fraud claims circulating on social media.

item.title: Por que resultado do primeiro turno não foi uma surpresa, segundo CEO de instituto de pesquisa
item.description: Cila Schulman, CEO of the Ideia Institute of Research, explained that the outcome of the first round of the presidential election, with Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, was not surprising, attributing the result to a 'last-minute anti-PT sentiment'. She noted that voters migrated to Flávio in the final days of the campaign to prevent Lula from winning in the first round, describing this as a tactical vote common in elections. For the second round, Cila emphasized that Lula faces the challenge of mobilizing non-voters, while Flávio may continue to attract votes from defeated candidates, but warned about Lula needing a defined strategy to avoid internal discrepancies in his campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro firma compromissos com frente do agro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a presidential candidate in 2026, signed a commitment letter with the Front Parlamentar da Agropecuária (FPA) during a meeting in Brasília. He confirmed that the group will indicate the Minister of Agriculture in a potential government, reinforcing alliances with rural sectors.

item.title: OEA elogia eleição no Brasil, mas aponta preocupação com desinformação
item.description: The OAS praised Brazil's election, highlighting the transparency of the process and the TSE's efficiency, but warned about strong polarization, misinformation, and the absence of presidential debates. The mission observed 91 experts and noted technological advances such as biometrics for 89% of voters and the use of digital platforms for self-service.

item.title: Votou, mas visualizou mensagem de ‘faltou’? Condição não é definitiva, afirma TSE
item.description: Following the first round of the 2026 elections, some voters who attended the polls saw a 'did not vote' message on the Electoral Court's website. The TSE clarifies that the data is still being processed and the message is not final, subject to updates until October 11. Voters are advised to wait until this date before taking action.

item.title: A nova pesquisa sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula no terceiro maior colégio eleitoral do Centro-Oeste
item.description: The new Quaest survey, scheduled for release on October 12, measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the Federal District in the runoff, in addition to investigating the race for governor between Celina Leão and Leandro Grass. The survey covers voting intention, candidate image, attributes such as experience and honesty, and expectations of victory.

item.title: Marçal no STF? Influenciador se oferece para “tocar o terror”
item.description: Pablo Marçal stated he would accept any position in a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration, including a Supreme Court seat. Duda Teixeira and Carlos Graieb discuss possible nominees to the Supreme Court, mentioning Maria Claudia Bucchianeri and Maria do Carmo Cardoso, and highlight Flávio's potential choice of a female candidate. The discussion also touches on the PT's political platform.

item.title: Campanha de Paes acusa Garotinho de 'manipular' eleição, muda de posição e pede ao TSE para manter seus votos
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) campaign requested the TSE to keep Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) votes in the Rio election result, after changing position on his candidacy. Paes accuses Garotinho of manipulating the electoral process by abandoning a lawsuit seeking to validate his votes, which could benefit Douglas Ruas (PL) and secure his first-round victory.

item.title: Gilmar arquiva pedido de investigação contra Gaspar, vice de Flávio, por estupro de vulnerável
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes dismissed the request to investigate Alfredo Gaspar, running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), over alleged Vulnerable Person Rape charges. The Public Prosecutor’s Office supported the dismissal due to insufficient evidence for an inquiry. The accusation, filed by Lindbergh Farias and Soraya Thronicke, included claims of teenage pregnancy and attempted bribery.

item.title: Após apoio da bancada do agro, Flávio promete Ministério da Agricultura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro secured formal backing from the agribusiness parliamentary bloc (FAP) for the runoff, pledging to appoint an agriculture minister selected by the caucus and align with agribusiness priorities. He emphasized infrastructure, research, and biofuels investments, while federal deputy Pedro Lupion launched sharp criticism of Lula’s administration, citing deficits, public debt, and high interest rates as barriers to productive investment.

item.title: Federação União-PP anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno
item.description: The União-PP Federation decided to support Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, strengthening strategic alliances for the 2026 elections. The announcement follows meetings with party leaders and reflects PL's support for Celina Leão and Mailza Assis. Flávio highlighted talks with centrist parties like Republicanos and Podemos to expand his backing.

item.title: Bruno Soller: virada de Lula é “quase impossível” no 2º turno
item.description: Political scientist Bruno Soller, from Real Time Big Data, claims that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s comeback in the 2026 runoff is “almost impossible,” with Flávio Bolsonaro as the favorite. For a reversal, Lula would need about 65% of the votes from Cesar Cury, Geraldo Caiado, Zema, and Renan Calheiros. Soller also warns that betting on voter abstention is unlikely to work.

item.title: TSE marca para quinta (8) julgamento sobre candidatura de Garotinho e que definirá eleição no RJ
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) scheduled Thursday (8) for the hearing on Anthony Garotinho's candidacy, former governor of Rio de Janeiro, which may determine whether the state will have a gubernatorial runoff. The judicial decision will be pivotal for the state's gubernatorial race.

item.title: A 1ª pesquisa Quaest sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro no DF
item.description: The first Quaest poll in the Federal District for the second round between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will be released next Monday, based on 1,104 interviews conducted between October 8 and 11. The poll, with a three percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level, will also examine voter preference between Celina Leão (PP) and Leandro Grass (PT) for governor of the DF. Voting takes place on October 25.

item.title: Lula busca apoio de PSD, Republicanos e PP
item.description: PT national president Edinho Silva reached out to PSD and Republicanos leaders to seek support for Lula in the runoff. The PSD stated it will remain neutral but allowed PT to contact members of the party.

item.title: PT conversa com Republicanos e mira líderes do PSD no 2º turno
item.description: The PT seeks alliances with leaders from Republicanos and PSD for the second round, engaging with figures like Edinho Silva, Marcos Pereira, and Gilberto Kassab. The PSD maintains official neutrality but allows its members to dialogue with both candidates, while Flávio Bolsonaro gains support from coalitions and figures like Tarcísio de Freitas and Michel Temer.

item.title: TSE julga na quinta-feira caso de Garotinho que pode definir se haverá segundo turno no Rio
item.description: The TSE will rule on Thursday on Garotinho's appeal regarding 274,411 votes from the first round, a case that may determine whether there will be a runoff in Rio.

item.title: OEA vê 'clima de tensão' na eleição, cita 'ativismo internacional' e cobra mais segurança jurídica no segundo turno
item.description: The OAS released a preliminary report on its election observation mission in Brazil, highlighting a tense climate, political polarization, and international activism, calling for greater legal security in the second round. The mission criticized public statements by heads of state on elections in the continent and foreign actors influencing the campaign trail. It also raised concerns over single-judge rulings that, according to the OAS, placed the judiciary at the center of the electoral contest.
